data.name: Tejveer
data.long_meaning: Tejveer is a name of Sanskrit origin which means 'Brave, Victorious'. This name is derived from two words - 'Tej' meaning 'Might, Power, Radiance, Strength, Virtue, Victory' and 'Veer' meaning 'Hero, Brave'. The name Tejveer signifies a person who is powerful, strong, and courageous.

The name inspires individuals to strive for victory in their personal and professional lives and to embody the qualities of a true hero.
